package dynamoevents

import (
	\"encoding/json\"
	\"testing\"

	\"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/aws\"
	\"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/service/dynamodb\"
	\"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/service/dynamodb/dynamodbattribute\"
	\"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
)

func TestFieldsMapRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	original := "'`{"emptyObject":{},"emptyList":[],"nested":{"null":null,"strings":["", "value"],"bool":false},"large":12345678901234567890123456789012345678,"decimal":1.2345e-6,"a.b":"queryable"}`
	mapped, err := fieldsMapAttribute(original)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, mapped.M)
	require.Equal(t, "queryable", aws.StringValue(mapped.M["a.b"].S))
	require.NotNil(t, mapped.M["emptyObject"].M)
	require.NotNil(t, mapped.M["emptyList"].L)
	require.Equal(t, "12345678901234567890123456789012345678", aws.StringValue(mapped.M["large"].N))

	item, err := marshalEvent(event{SessionID: "session", EventIndex: 3, Fields: original})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotContains(t, item, "Fields")
	require.NotNil(t, item["FieldsMap"].M)

	var decoded event
	require.NoError(t, dynamodbattribute.UnmarshalMap(item, &decoded))
	data, err := eventFieldsJSON(item)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var expected, actual interface{}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(original))
	decoder.UseNumber()
	require.NoError(t, decoder.Decode(&expected))
	decoder = json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(data))
	decoder.UseNumber()
	require.NoError(t, decoder.Decode(&actual))
	require.Equal(t, expected, actual)
}

func TestFieldsMapReadCompatibility(t *testing.T) {
	legacy := map[string]*dynamodb.AttributeValue{"Fields": {S: aws.String(`{"key":"old"}`)}}
	data, err := eventFieldsJSON(legacy)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.JSONEq(t, `{"key":"old"}`, data)

	legacy["FieldsMap"] = &dynamodb.AttributeValue{M: map[string]*dynamodb.AttributeValue{"key": {S: aws.String("new")}}}
	data, err = eventFieldsJSON(legacy)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.JSONEq(t, `{"key":"new"}`, data)
}

func TestFieldsMapRejectsInvalidData(t *testing.T) {
	for _, input := range []string{"", "null", "[]", `{"field":1} {}`, `{"field":`, `"string"`} {
		_, err := fieldsMapAttribute(input)
		require.Error(t, err, input)
	}
	_, err := eventFieldsJSON(map[string]*dynamodb.AttributeValue{})
	require.Error(t, err)
	_, err = eventFieldsJSON(map[string]*dynamodb.AttributeValue{"FieldsMap": {S: aws.String("wrong type")}})
	require.Error(t, err)
}
EOF'

DynamoDB audit events now write metadata as a native `FieldsMap`. Reads accept both `FieldsMap` and legacy `Fields` while a locked background migration converts existing rows in batches. The migration saves its scan cursor, retries after failures, and validates the converted metadata.
